findings.finding: One status query collapses calculation, publication, lock, and revision dimensions without precedence semantics.
findings.resolution: Define orthogonal versioned filters while retaining an explicit 1.3 compatibility behavior; do not guess a predicate.
findings.testEvidence: Score unit and E2E coverage pass; PostgreSQL integration explicitly verifies mutually exclusive CALCULATED/PUBLISHED predicates.
findings.residualRisk: Frozen 1.3 clients keep the documented compatibility vocabulary; candidate metadata and projections are explicit.

findings.finding: No generic OpenAPI 3.1 validator currently checks real HTTP requests, statuses, content types, success bodies, and error bodies.
findings.resolution: Add a pinned JSON Schema 2020-12 validator, real HTTP exchange instrumentation, and a complete operation coverage registry.
findings.testEvidence: Strict real-HTTP E2E conformance validates success and error/access exchanges for every operation.
findings.residualRisk: Future drift is rejected by the deterministic E2E and CI conformance gate.

findings.finding: The existing comparator defaults to 1.1 to 1.2 and omits several required request, response, security, format, nullable, composition, and permission changes.
findings.resolution: Pin the frozen 1.3 baseline, implement direction-aware change classification and fixture tests, and wire contract:compatibility:check into CI.
findings.testEvidence: Five direction-aware compatibility fixtures and the frozen-baseline gate pass.
findings.residualRisk: Future exceptions require owner, reason, expiry, and migration reference.

findings.finding: There is no current 1.3-based immutable snapshot, release manifest, deterministic diff, changelog, migration note, handoff, or release check command.
findings.resolution: Create deterministic contract:release:prepare and contract:release:check workflows rooted at the verified 1.3 artifact.
findings.testEvidence: Deterministic release prepare/check and stale-or-tampered artifact detection pass.
findings.residualRisk: Release artifacts must be regenerated after the candidate source commit is created.

findings.finding: npm audit reports two production High findings through js-yaml 4.3.0.
findings.resolution: Upgrade @nestjs/swagger from 11.4.5 to the compatible 11.4.6 fix and rerun the full and production-only audits plus all gates.
findings.testEvidence: Full and production-only npm audits report zero vulnerabilities.
findings.residualRisk: Normal dependency update monitoring remains required.

findings.finding: Redocly reports six warnings: missing license metadata, three operations without 4XX responses, and two unused schemas.
findings.resolution: Resolve only evidence-backed warnings; do not invent a license or fake responses, and use the narrowest justified suppression where semantics require it.
findings.testEvidence: Redocly reports zero unsuppressed warnings; five exact semantic suppressions are documented and scoped.
findings.residualRisk: Suppression count and location remain visible and reviewable.

findings.finding: The README contains multiple historical operation and test totals that can be mistaken for current 122-operation status.
findings.resolution: Mark historical stage evidence explicitly and make the generated current handoff/matrix the only current status pointer.
findings.testEvidence: README has an explicit current-authority banner and links to generated current status.
findings.residualRisk: Historical text remains preserved as prior-stage evidence.

findings.finding: Authentication rate limiting is process-local and resets or diverges across production instances.
findings.resolution: Replace the production binding with a shared durable implementation and retain an explicit test-only adapter where useful.
findings.testEvidence: PostgreSQL concurrency/reset integration and authentication rate-limit tests pass.
findings.residualRisk: Database availability is intentionally required for production enforcement.

findings.finding: Public QR join rate limiting is also process-local and not production-coherent across instances.
findings.resolution: Move counters to a shared durable boundary with atomic window enforcement and bounded retention.
findings.testEvidence: Concurrent public QR-join integration and security coverage pass against PostgreSQL.
findings.residualRisk: Operational retention uses bounded-window cleanup in the adapter.

findings.finding: Runtime coverage proves route presence but does not yet publish the required final completion/visibility/conformance status matrix.
findings.resolution: Produce a generated operation completion matrix with one allowed state, visibility reason, policy evidence, and conformance coverage per operation.
findings.testEvidence: Generated matrix accounts for all 122 operations and runtime coverage/conformance gates pass.
findings.residualRisk: 18 disabled operations remain deliberately unavailable and fail closed.

findings.finding: HTTP status is machine-governed, but lifecycle classification is not yet a single machine-readable runtime source.
findings.resolution: Extend the canonical registry with lifecycle and verify contract-only, runtime-only, deprecated, compatibility, and reserved sets.
findings.testEvidence: Parity governs 151 lifecycle rows (110 runtime, 41 reserved) and E2E validates error envelopes.
findings.residualRisk: New codes require explicit lifecycle classification before parity can pass.

findings.finding: CI lacks runtime conformance, full compatibility/breaking, release checks, production-only audit, and inventory/report consistency gates.
findings.resolution: Wire each deterministic command into Backend CI without continue-on-error or weakened thresholds.
findings.testEvidence: PR #4 Backend CI succeeded for both push and pull_request events, including the explicit inventory and runtime-conformance gates.
findings.residualRisk: GitHub reports a non-blocking Node 20 action-runtime deprecation annotation for checkout/setup-node v4; upgrade when GitHub publishes the approved next major actions.

findings.symbolOrOperation: origin and authenticated GitHub browser session
findings.finding: The checkout initially had no Git remote and no gh executable, so repository identity, default branch, and an authenticated PR mechanism required independent verification before delivery.
findings.resolution: Verified chchaiai/BNBU-Sports-Backend in an authenticated GitHub session, confirmed main as the default branch and 4b4f88b as the published Contract 1.3 commit, then configured that repository as origin.
findings.evidence: GitHub repository page and exact commit page; git ls-remote --symref origin HEAD; git remote -v.
findings.testEvidence: Authenticated GitHub inspection and git ls-remote verified repository/default branch/baseline; non-force push created PR #4 and both push and pull_request Backend CI runs succeeded.
findings.residualRisk: No delivery blocker remains; PR merge and post-merge release remain human-controlled.

findings.finding: Generated Prisma sources contain @ts-nocheck and any by upstream design.
findings.resolution: Retain generated output; verify generator freshness instead of hand-editing it.
findings.testEvidence: Generated artifact check passed at baseline.
findings.residualRisk: Upstream generator typing remains outside handwritten-source policy.

findings.finding: CLI scripts intentionally use console output and throw Error to report deterministic gate failures.
findings.resolution: Retain command-line diagnostics; production HTTP error handling remains separately governed.
findings.testEvidence: Baseline gates returned deterministic exit codes and messages.
findings.residualRisk: None for production HTTP behavior because these paths are build/test commands.

findings.finding: No describe.skip, it.skip, test.skip, describe.only, it.only, or test.only marker was found in executable backend tests.
findings.resolution: No code change required; retain an automated scan and test-run skip/todo counts.
findings.evidence: repository-wide tracked-file scan at the baseline commit
findings.testEvidence: Automated scan and final layer runs report zero skipped, todo, or focused tests.
findings.residualRisk: Future skipped tests must be rejected by the closure scan.

findings.finding: The sandbox identity cannot access the daemon, while the approved unsandboxed interactive identity can access Docker Desktop with an isolated empty DOCKER_CONFIG.
findings.resolution: Run required Docker validation under the verified interactive identity with the task-specific empty configuration; do not read personal Docker credentials or add the sandbox account to docker-users.
findings.evidence: CodexSandboxOffline: daemon pipe denied; interactive user 23328: Client 29.6.2 and Server 29.6.2, Linux Engine.
findings.testEvidence: Interactive identity Docker Client/Server 29.6.2 verified with an isolated empty DOCKER_CONFIG; no-cache build and runtime smoke are final-gate evidence.
findings.residualRisk: Docker commands require approved unsandboxed execution for this task.
